region: Canada, 16 stations incl. Quesnel, Smithers, Terrace, Fort St John BC
estimator: Sen slope with Mann Kendall test beside ordinary least squares with t test
period: 1965 to 2008 (27 yr), 1956 to 2005 (49 yr), 1926 to 2001 (66 yr), non-consecutive years
autocorrelation_treatment: lag one tested per Salas et al. 1980 and found absent after homogenisation; no correction applied
multiple_testing: Benjamini and Hochberg false discovery rate field significance at alpha 0.05
trend_result: no slope reported; homogenisation changed trend significance at up to 50 per cent of stations for P90, 40 per cent for IQR, 20 per cent for median
note: DC restarted each spring without overwintering; RH breakpoints at dewcel changeover 1970s to 1990s; thesis full text 107 pages

multiple_testing: station p values by month-region group; no correction stated
trend_result: increasing location trends at most stations in May, July and August; decreasing scale in August in some regions; no slope given
note: no open copy; registry abstract only

estimator: bootstrap corrected likelihood ratio trend test in a generalised extreme value model

note: no open copy; registry abstract only

note: AMS HTML full text; Table 3 values not in the text layer; year 2010 by volume though DOI prefix reads 2009

autocorrelation_treatment: power spectral density of the autocorrelation function
trend_result: no trend reported; peaks of 3.5, 9 and 26 years in the Monthly Drought Code
note: century series are composites of successive stations

note: ERA5 not stations; endpoint sensitivity noted
